import { uv, vec3, mix, smoothstep, float, sub, length, oneMinus } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

  const COLORS = (config.intent && config.intent.visualSpec && config.intent.visualSpec.colors) || {};
  const BG = COLORS.background || '#0b0b10';
  const SURFACE = COLORS.surface || '#14141a';
  const INK = COLORS.ink || '#16161d';
  const PAPER = COLORS.paper || '#e8ecf2';
  const ACCENT = COLORS.accent || '#ff2a38';

  const group = new Group();
  const disposables = [];
  const timelines = [];

  const bgGeo = new PlaneGeometry(7, 6);
  const bgMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  const c0 = vec3(new Color(BG).toArray());
  const c1 = vec3(new Color('#101017').toArray());
  const c2 = vec3(new Color(INK).toArray());
  const v = uv().y;
  const lower = mix(c0, c1, smoothstep(float(0.0), float(0.65), v));
  const grad = mix(lower, c2, smoothstep(float(0.65), float(1.0), v));
  // subtle radial lift toward center so the stage never reads flat void
  const d = length(uv().sub(0.5));
  bgMat.colorNode = mix(grad.mul(float(1.15)), grad, smoothstep(float(0.1), float(0.6), d));
  const backdrop = new Mesh(bgGeo, bgMat);
  backdrop.position.set(0, 0, -3);
  group.add(backdrop);
  disposables.push(bgGeo, bgMat);

  const arcGeo = new CircleGeometry(2.4, 64);
  const arcMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({ color: new Color(SURFACE), roughness: 0.85, metalness: 0.2 });
  const arc = new Mesh(arcGeo, arcMat);
  arc.position.set(0.2, 0.1, -1.6);
  group.add(arc);
  disposables.push(arcGeo, arcMat);

  const ambient = new AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.07);
  const key = new PointLight(new Color('#ffb37a'), 9, 10, 2);
  key.position.set(1.8, 0.7, 1.9);
  const fill = new PointLight(new Color('#c9924f'), 3, 8, 2);
  fill.position.set(-2.2, 0.4, 1.2);
  const rim = new DirectionalLight(new Color('#fff0dc'), 1.2);
  rim.position.set(-0.8, 2.6, -2.4);
